maria (emb-ml): rolling up results from the crane-compact INT8 bring-up on staging. quick summary first: int8 per-channel build looks good perf-wise (~2.3x throughput) but there's a small quality delta on short queries and some cluster drift in the title-search set. attaching quick numbers below.

kevin (infra): nice. did you pin the exact quantization config? per-channel symmetric or asymmetric?

maria (emb-ml): per-channel symmetric, blocksize=128, no fp16 fallback. used quant-config: `--mode=int8 --scheme=per_channel_sym --block=128 --calib=kl`

aisha (eval): paste of the main eval metrics (staging vs baseline float):
```
Dataset: title-search-10k
metrics: recall@1, recall@10, silhouette
float (baseline):  recall@1=0.62, recall@10=0.88, silhouette=0.24
int8  (crane):     recall@1=0.58, recall@10=0.82, silhouette=0.18
delta:              -0.04,     -0.06,     -0.06
```

ciaran (onboard): hmm 6 point drop at R@10 is a bit concerning. what's the query length distribution for this dataset? maybe short queries lose more under quantization.

maria (emb-ml): yep we split by length: short (<8 tokens), med (8-32), long (>32). short queries showed biggest hit: R@1 0.51 -> 0.43, med and long mostly within 0.02.

aisha (eval): that suggests calibration skew for short-prefix patterns. I also ran centroid shift analysis per-class (kmeans-50): mean cosine shift per centroid went from 0.012 (float) to 0.034 (int8). some small clusters moved more.

maria (emb-ml): threw together a quick UMAP view — staging int8 shows more cluster overlap for the product-title classes, uMAP coords look noisier.

kevin (infra): is the runtime doing any additional topk-normalization / L2 rescaling after quant? we previously saw scale mismatch when embeddings were output in int8 and then cast back to float without original scale.

maria (emb-ml): output is cast back to float using stored scale per-channel, but we may be using per-tensor bias that was dropped. I'll double-check the post-dequant pipeline.

aisha (eval): quick ablation ideas: 1) try asymmetric per-channel (often helps short tokens), 2) smaller blocksize (64) to preserve local weights, 3) re-run KL vs MSE calibration.

ciaran (onboard): agree. also let's run the same eval on our multilingual holdout (en+es+de) — quant can affect non-en more.

maria (emb-ml): queued multilingual job. also ran a small rerank sim-check on short queries vs passages, raw sim diffs: average cosine(float)=0.78, cosine(int8)=0.73 for top-10.

eval-bot: test-run queued: /evals/run --model crane-compact-int8 --datasets title-search-10k,multi-holdout-5k --calibs "kl,mse" --block-sizes "128,64" --schemes "per_channel_sym,per_channel_asym"

kevin (infra): perf numbers? what's throughput/latency delta?

maria (emb-ml): perf is solid: float baseline 120 qps per GPU, int8 280 qps (batching same). p99 latency float=46ms, int8=38ms. so latency improved and memory footprint down ~60%.

aisha (eval): next steps proposal:
- run ablation grid (block 128/64, scheme sym/asym, calib KL/MSE)
- compute per-length recall deltas and per-class centroid shift summaries
- sanity-check post-dequant scaling pipeline and add unit to guard against missing scale/bias
- compare to 4-bit PTQ if we can get a stable run

ciaran (onboard): timeline? if ablation shows any combo within 0.01 R@10 of baseline we can greenlight staged rollout behind feature flag. otherwise we'll keep the float for short-query routes and use int8 for long-query heavy routes.

maria (emb-ml): I can run the ablation overnight. will post a short summary with the best candidate and a small explainer for console ops (routing rules).

kevin (infra): when you post results tag me and I'll validate operator toggles and capacity forecasts.

aisha (eval): FYI I'll add a small eval that measures downstream rerank MRR — sometimes recall changes don't capture rerank sensitivity.

maria (emb-ml): thanks. quick note: logs from the initial run attached to staging build 202803_crane_int8. if anyone wants quick eyeballs ping me and I'll share the UMAP + centroid diff plots. :eyes:

kevin (infra): :thumbsup:

ciaran (onboard): tagging this as "onboard-int8-crane" in our internal tracking. good triage.

maria (emb-ml): ok will update with ablation outputs tomorrow morning. short action items: aisha run MRR test, kevin validate scaling path, me run ablation + multilingual.

aisha (eval): got it.

kevin (infra): will do.

maria (emb-ml): thanks all.
